connector.name: Short Video Agent Kit
connector.registryDescription: Provider-neutral short-form AI video toolkit for agents: Sora, Gemini Veo, xAI/Grok, Seedance.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package short-video-agent-kit. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the davidmosiah account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SHORT_VIDEO_DRY_RUN
env.description: Set to false only when the agent should call paid video providers. Defaults to dry-run behavior.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: Optional API key for OpenAI/Sora provider calls.

env.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
env.description: Optional API key for Gemini Veo provider calls.

env.name: XAI_API_KEY
env.description: Optional API key for xAI/Grok provider calls.
